messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need a compact launch email sequence for the benchmarking webinar + a short newsletter plug. Goal: 3 emails (announce, reminder, last-chance) + 1 newsletter blurb. Drafts ready?
Ashok Patel: I sketched copy for announce/reminder. Kept it product-light, benefit-heavy. Want to A/B subject lines for announce (benchmarks vs cost/latency).
Tom R.: For segmentation, target: PLG signups (early adopters), engaged docs readers, and paid trialers. Different CTA for each (signup for benchmark demo / save your seat / request presale).
Olivia Nguyen: Can we reuse the webinar landing copy? We should include the TL;DR benchmark takeaway in the newsletter blurb to drive curiosity.
Kai (Growth): +1 on A/B. Also propose a tiny cohort: 10% of PLG gets subject focusing on latency numbers, 10% gets cost-per-token angle, rest control. Track open -> registration -> conversion.
Maria Chen: Sounds good. Ashok, can you drop the two announce subject variants and a 2-line preheader? Tom, can you map CTAs to email tags for routing?
Ashok Patel: Dropped here: Subject A: "New inference benchmarks: 2x throughput at 30% lower cost"; Subject B: "How teams cut LLM serving latency in half — webinar"; Preheader (both): "Real-world rigs, configs, and what worked."
Tom R.: CTA mapping: PLG -> /signup?src=email_bench; Docs readers -> /webinar?src=docs_news; Trialers -> /demo-request?src=email_bench. I'll add UTM tags and pass to support for routing.
Olivia Nguyen: Newsletter blurb draft: "Benchmarked in the wild: Our latest tests show model X + quantized profile Y delivers predictable throughput and lower infra spend. Join our webinar for implementation notes and a live Q&A." Keep it one sentence in the header, then a 1-liner with CTA.
Maria Chen: Nice. Kai, how do we handle reminders cadence and segmentation windows?
Kai (Growth): Reminders: 72h, 24h, 1h. For paid trialers exclude 1h if they're in APAC to avoid weird hours. Use timezone send windows. Also add an exclude filter for anyone registered.
LaunchBot: Reminder: webinar registration page created at https://redwood.example/webinar/benchmarking-2026 — tracking pixel enabled.
Ashok Patel: Quick question on tone: founders vs engineers — should announce be slightly more technical?
Maria Chen: Keep the announce mid-level technical. Newsletter blurb can skew higher-level, but the webinar description must call out specific takeaways for engineers (configs, kernels, quant profiles).
Tom R.: Ops note: for inbound lead routing, route registrants to SDR queue 'bench-webinar-registrants' with tags: eval_interest, infra, enterprise. Can we add auto-note: "attended:pending" then update post-event?
Olivia Nguyen: I'll prepare the HTML snippet for the newsletter and a plain-text fallback. Also prepping a 1-sentence social caption for the same copy.
Kai (Growth): Tracking plan: register->attend->demo_request. We'll set conversion funnel in GA + segment in HubSpot. Also create a small experiment: one cohort gets benchmark chart inline vs no-chart.
Maria Chen: Action items: Ashok — finalize three email bodies + subjects by EOD; Tom — UTM/CTA mapping & routing rules; Olivia — newsletter HTML + social caption; Kai — cohort split config + tracking. I'll run final QA tomorrow morning.
Ashok Patel: On it.
Tom R.: Got it.
Olivia Nguyen: ETA EOD.
Kai (Growth): I'll schedule the cohort split and share the spreadsheet.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. If anything blocks, ping here. :rocket:
thread_summary: Planning thread for newsletter + 3-email launch sequence for benchmarking webinar; assigns copy, segmentation, CTA routing, reminders, tracking, and cohort A/B tests.
